verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs say it automatically captures action items and next steps and "assigns" them, and it can push them into tracking tools such as Jira, Asana and ClickUp; its API also exposes action items. However, owner attribution is only implied by the word "assigned", tracking relies on third-party tools rather than a documented native tracker, and all evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-item owner attribution, a documented native action-item tracking view, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Clear next steps are automatically captured and assigned from every meeting.
Otter turns every meeting into a clear summary with decisions, action items, and insights.
Help your team move faster by sending actions items from meetings into tools they already use, like JIRA, Asana, and others.
Send meeting summaries and action items from Otter to ClickUp to manage everything in one place.
Stay on track by automatically turning your meeting notes into simple action items with deadlines.
Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
